predictions.question: The Exp66/91 straggle anchors (3/5/9 nm at 5/10/20 keV) are declared SRIM-scale assumptions and now carry 70% of the P91 variance. Does an in-house binary-collision Monte Carlo (ZBL potential, magic-formula scattering, Lindhard-Scharff electronic stopping) for P into amorphous Si reproduce that scale, and does the P91 budget + 5 keV optimum survive computed straggle?
predictions.method: BCA: P (Z=15, M=31) into Si (N=5.0e22/cm3); mean free path L=N^-1/3; impact parameter p = pmax*sqrt(rand), pmax = L/sqrt(pi); ZBL screening with magic-formula scattering angle; nuclear energy transfer kinematics; LS velocity-proportional electronic loss per step; stop at E<25 eV or z>300 nm. N>=2000 ions at 3/4/5/6/7.5/10/15/20 keV, fixed RNG seed recorded. Outputs: lateral sigma_x(E), projected range Rp(E) (sanity vs literature scale: P 10 keV Rp ~13-15 nm). Budget: Exp91 P91 terms with straggle replaced by BCA curve (log-interp), recompute sigma_total and energy optimum. Honest labels: amorphous target (no channeling), classical BCA, no recombination/damage chemistry.
predictions.success_rule: BO1 and BO2: BCA sigma_x at 5/10/20 keV within +/-40% of the 3/5/9 anchors, and sigma_total(P91 with BCA straggle) <= 4.2 nm.
predictions: BO1 ANCHOR SCALE: BCA lateral sigma_x at 5, 10, 20 keV each within +/-40% of 3, 5, 9 nm.
BO2 BUDGET SURVIVES: sigma_total at P91 terms with BCA straggle(5 keV) <= 4.2 nm.
BO3 OPTIMUM STAYS: energy of minimum sigma_total (P91 terms, BCA straggle curve) lies in [4, 6] keV.
BO4 RANGE SANITY: BCA projected range Rp(10 keV) in [8, 22] nm.

iradina_validation_anchor.note: Matches 3D iradina 1.2.3 within ~1-2% after fixing legacy rmax=R0+80 truncation bug (OBS-039).
